description: RS-485/RS-422 transceiver, half duplex, 3.3 V supply, 10 Mbps, 32 unit loads, 5 V tolerant logic (SOIC-8, 75176 pinout): the common 3.3 V RS485 module chip

package.name: SOIC-8
package.page: 8-pin NSOIC (ordering information); standard JEDEC MS-012 footprint by name

pins.name: RO
pins.description: receiver output (high impedance while RE is high)

pins.name: A
pins.description: noninverting driver output and receiver input

pins.name: B
pins.description: inverting driver output and receiver input

recommended.what: operating temperature (E grade; C grade 0 to 70)

parameters.conditions: no load, driver and receiver enabled (RE, DI = 0 V or VCC; DE = VCC), VCC=3.3 V +/-5 %, TAMB=TMIN to TMAX; receiver only (DE=0 V) is 300 uA typ

parts.rating: at each end of the bus only

notes: RE and DE are usually tied together and driven by one GPIO (high = transmit); RO to the UART RX, DI to its TX.
Terminate the bus at its two ends only, 120 ohm across A-B.
support.page: pin function; electrical characteristics (VCC = 3.3 V ± 5 %); typical half-duplex network

notes: Same pins as the MAX3485 and the 5 V MAX485 (75176 pinout).
The logic inputs take 5 V, so a 5 V MCU may drive it; RO swings to 3.3 V.
Bias resistors (e.g. 680 ohm A to VCC and B to GND at one node) keep an idle terminated bus defined; a TVS at the connector for long buses.

pins.source: Exar SP3485 datasheet (rev. 1.0.0, 06/19/12): pin function, absolute maximum ratings, electrical characteristics (VCC = 3.3 V ± 5 %), ordering information (8-pin NSOIC); read from the copy the distributor hosts (https://www.lcsc.com/datasheet/C8963.pdf)
